title: User-confirmed and verified dataset acquisition
description: Adds a dedicated experiment-stage workflow for locating existing data, confirming a default or custom destination, performing real downloads, validating integrity, and stopping with structured user choices when acquisition is blocked.
changes: Check real local paths before asking or downloading.
Offer the active run experiment/data directory as the recommended destination.
Disclose source, size, license, authentication, and subset before download.
Treat short connectivity probes as diagnostics rather than completed download attempts.
Verify file integrity and a minimal read before handing data to experiments.
Use a structured user question for unrecoverable proxy, authentication, storage, URL, or source failures.
Block real-data experiments and final paper claims while acquisition remains unresolved.
